chunks: And ʿAmr ibn Shimr narrated from Jābir ibn Yazīd al-Juʿfī, from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام, who said:
Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله: “Indeed, I have thanked Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib for four qualities.”

So the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله called him and informed him. He said: “Had Allah, Blessed and Exalted, not informed you, I would not have told you. I have never drunk wine, because I knew that if I drank it, my intellect would depart. I have never lied, because lying diminishes honor. I have never committed adultery, because I feared that if I did it, it would be done to me. And I have never worshipped an idol, because I knew that it neither harms nor benefits.”

He said: Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله placed his hand on his shoulder and said: “It is a right upon Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, that He grant you two wings with which you will fly with the angels in Paradise.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَ خِصَالٍ: four virtuous qualities for which Jaʿfar was praised
key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةَ: manly honor, dignity, and moral nobility
key_terms.جَنَاحَيْنِ: two wings granted as an honor in Paradise
key_terms.خَمْرًا: wine or intoxicant, avoided because it removes intellect

ai.seo_question: What four qualities did Allah praise in Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib, and what was his reward in Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts how Allah honored Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib for four noble qualities: abstaining from wine, truthfulness, chastity, and rejecting idol worship. It highlights the moral insight and innate purity of Jaʿfar, and concludes with the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم glad tidings that he will be granted two wings in Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5847 - Amr ibn Shimr narrated from Jabir ibn Yazid Al-Jufi, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon him, who said:
"Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him and his family: 'I have thanked Jafar ibn Abi Talib (as) for four qualities.'
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, called him and informed him.
Jafar (as) said: 'If Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, had not informed you, I would not have told you. I have never drunk wine because I knew if I drank it, my mind would be gone. I have never lied because lying diminishes honor. I have never committed adultery because I feared that if I did it, the same would be done to me. I have never worshiped an idol because I knew it could neither harm nor benefit.'
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, placed his hand on Jafar's (as) shoulder and said: 'It is a right upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, to grant you two wings with which you will fly with the angels in Paradise.'"
